task: F1 repair gap #2 - independent visual fidelity review

findings.title: Provisional caption row overflows its grid area at live widths >= 900px
findings.rootCause: #island is a direct child of the #document-surface grid but receives no grid-row/grid-column at any width; at >=900px the explicit three-column live layout auto-places it into a mismatched implicit track, and #island .island__text has word-break:keep-all with no min-inline-size:0, overflow, or text-overflow, so long provisional Korean text shears mid-glyph at both edges.
findings.whyMissed: task-18/capture-qa.ts:101 measures rootOverflow as documentElement.scrollWidth - clientWidth only; intra-grid overflow is invisible to it. task-18/screenshots/1280x800-live-capturing.png renders the same island cleanly because its caption text is short.

findings.title: #btn-review renders as a completely empty control at <= 420px
findings.rootCause: #btn-review markup contains only a label span and a hidden count span with no icon element. .review-btn__label{display:none} at <=420px hides the sole visible child while min-width/min-height 44px keeps the box, producing a blank 44x44 control. .review-btn__icon at public/style.css:1233 is a dead selector matching no element; the sibling .attendee-btn__icon has real markup at public/index.html:66 and degrades correctly.
designViolations: 9.12 icon-only controls keep an accessible name
findings.whyMissed: #btn-review ships hidden (public/index.html:69) and is absent from task-18/screenshots/320x667-library-populated.ax.json, so the task-18 narrow sweep never rendered it. Todo 19 product defect fix 2 first made it reachable; fix 4 corrected its target size to 44px without restoring visible content.

findings.title: .action-card__btn label truncated mid-word at 320px
findings.detail: First action button renders 'Send follow-' cut mid-word with no ellipsis; two adjacent action buttons render with no legible label.
findings.rootCause: .action-card__btn has fixed padding 0 12px and no min-inline-size:0, overflow, or text-overflow inside a wrapping flex row; the <=375px media rule enforces 44px box minimums but does nothing for text handling.
designViolations: 9.13 capability legible where the action lives

residualRisks: No post-redesign LIVE capture exists at 1440x900 or 1244x836, the two viewports DESIGN 9.9 names as reference comparisons. Two current captures at these widths were published concurrently by a sibling repair session (final/f1-repair/accessibility-repair/installed-viewports/viewport-1440x900-library.png and viewport-1244x836-library.png) and were inspected; both are library shell at idle capture phase and render cleanly, so neither exercises the live side-by-side seam. FAIL-V1 at those two widths remains reasoned from the CSS rule rather than directly observed.
The rootOverflow harness cannot detect overflow confined to a grid area or pane; a per-element scrollWidth>clientWidth check on text-bearing nodes is needed to close this class.
FAIL-V1 is content-length dependent; a re-capture with short synthetic caption text will render clean and falsely confirm a fix.
.review-btn__icon is a dead selector, indicating the empty-control state was unintended; the same class of defect can recur for any control whose only visible child is a responsively hidden label.
